### Lessons from a Pillar of Salt
Author: Jen Wilkin
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/lessons-from-a-pillar-of-salt/
Passage: Genesis 19:24-26
Points:
- True freedom from sin requires learning to hate it rather than harboring nostalgia for past self-worship.
- Lot's wife was dragged toward safety but looked back lingeringly with deep affection for Sodom.
- In antiquity, salt functioned mainly as a preservative rather than a table seasoning.
- Turning into salt memorialized her desire to preserve Sodom's corrupting influence, serving as a warning against compromised affections.
- Believers are challenged to fix their gaze forward on grace rather than backward toward sin.

### The Power of Prayer
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/power-prayer
Passage: Genesis 19:27-29
Points:
- Abraham returned to where he met God and witnessed the smoking ruins of Sodom, likely fearing his nephew had perished.
- Scripture explicitly states that God delivered Lot because He remembered Abraham and his intercession.
- God sovereignly chooses to use the persistent prayers of His people in rescuing wayward loved ones.
- Believers should remain steadfast and not lose heart when praying for unbelieving family members and friends.
- If God heeded Abraham's intercession, He will certainly answer the continual prayers of Christ on our behalf.
